purpose:
Draft standard-library summary for audited C2-B development archives.

Do not run before the formal data and authoritative audit schema are complete.
This consumes frozen recorded metrics, computes paired factor differences and
independently applies the predeclared development default-selection rule.
No simulator, RLS fitting/update, model prediction or held-out input is used.
All output is a new file outside the input archive. Source bytes and input
hashes are retained in that file; failed/incomplete trials remain in the report.

independent_development_selection.claim_boundary: Development default selection only; no unseen superiority, risk or skill claim.

selection_reconciliation.name_semantics: Candidate names omit _mpc; controller/evaluation names append _mpc.

audited_development_adoption_gate.tie_break: exact raw tracking mean, actual square effort mean, dimension, candidate id
audited_development_adoption_gate.claim_boundary: Development default only. No unseen method advantage, safety, or whole-body skill claim.

sample_semantics: Shared native transfers give two independent parameter updates; 3600 updates are not 3600 independent physical samples.
audited_rollout_semantics: Recorded future requests are offline conditional inputs. Initial native q/v only; future true states never fed back. Windows never cross reset, phase, missing, partial or stop. Full terminal endpoints are counted separately. Final-model calibration is in-sample, overlapping windows are not independent samples.
conditional_metric_semantics: All reported amplitude/block/target/switch/hold bins are retained per seed. returned_transition_count includes returned partial endpoints; known_substep_effort is not a per-transition average. No pooled bins or selected favorable blocks.
